messages.text: Heads up all: I'm out Jul 20 through Jul 31. Need someone to cover my book. Most of it is quiet but {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0267}} tends to call when markets get choppy.
Thanks Jonathan. Please log the coverage request in ClientHub so it's visible and put a coverage note on each household that's flagged high-touch. David, can you take primary?
Yep, I can be primary for those two weeks. I'm out Jul 27 though, so I'll need a backup for that last week. Tricia, any chance?
I can do Jul 27 to Jul 31 as backup. Just send me the briefing note ahead of time, especially anything with rebalancing pending in PortfolioMgr.

Will do. For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0267}}: low risk, brokerage account {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00551}}, been with us since 2018. Prefers phone over email. Contact details are in ClientHub, don't copy them into chat.
Makes sense. Is there anything scheduled for that account while you're away? Any distributions or rebalances I should expect?
Nothing hard scheduled. There's a quarterly rebalance flagged in PortfolioMgr but I'll run it before I leave on Jul 17 so you don't inherit it.
Reminder for everyone: coverage handoffs need a written note in ClientHub before your last day in. Verbal handoffs don't count when compliance asks for the audit trail.

Separate question: Janet is also out soon, right? Her client {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0198}} has both a brokerage and cash management account, {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00411}} and {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00412}}. Who's covering?
Good catch Tricia. Janet's away the week of Jul 13. I'll have you cover the portfolio side and David the relationship side. I'll confirm with her tomorrow.
Works for me. I'll check the ClientHub notes on that household first so I'm not caught flat-footed if they call.
Coverage note for my book is going into ClientHub tonight. I'll tag David and Tricia so you both get notified. Shout if anything's missing.
